# Aquaculture Opportunity Zones off the US West Coast
## Using Sea Surface Temperature (SST), bathymetry, and Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) data

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(here)
library(sf)          # vector handling
library(terra)       # raster handling
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)        # map making
library(viridisLite)
```

```{r}
# Import EEZ data and depth.tif
eez <- st_read(here("data", "wc_regions_clean.shp"))

depth <- rast(here("data", "depth.tif"))
```

```{r}
# Import SST and create raster stack

# Set directory for folder
sst_dir <- here::here("data", "sst")

# Create a list of all images that have the extension .tif and contain the word band
sst_rasters <- list.files(sst_dir,
                             pattern = glob2rx("*sst*.tif$"),
                             full.names = TRUE)

# Create a raster stack
sst_stack <- rast(sst_rasters) |> 
    terra::project("EPSG:4326") # Fix each raster's CRS
    # This was giving me trouble when I tried to stack sst and depth, so fixed here

```

```{r}
# Check CRS's !
if((st_crs(crs(depth)) == st_crs(crs(sst_stack))) & (st_crs(crs(depth)) == st_crs(crs(eez))) & (st_crs(crs(eez)) == st_crs(crs(sst_stack)))){
    print("CRS's match!")
  }else{
    print("CRS's DO NOT match!")
    st_crs(crs(eez))$epsg
    st_crs(crs(depth))$epsg
    st_crs(crs(sst_stack))$epsg
}
```

```{r}
# Find average SST and convert from Kelvin to Celsius
avg_sst <- mean(sst_stack, na.rm = TRUE) - 273.15
```


```{r}
# Crop and resample depth raster to match SST raster
depth_crop_resamp <- depth |> 
    crop(avg_sst) |> 
    resample(avg_sst, method = "bilinear")
```

```{r}
# Check that the depth and SST match in resolution, extent, and CRS's by stacking!
print(paste("Do CRS's match?", crs(depth_crop_resamp) == crs(avg_sst)))
# avg_sst_depth <- rast(c(avg_sst, depth_crop_resamp))
```

## Oyster Reclassification
```{r}
## OYSTERS ##
# sea surface temperature: 11-30°C
# depth: 0-70 meters below sea level

# aq_opportunity_zones <- function(sst_min, sst_max, depth_min, depth_max, species){}

# SST Reclassification Matrix

sst_rcl <- matrix(c(-Inf, 11, 0, # values -Inf to min = 0
                    11, 30, 1,  # values min to max = 1
                    30, Inf, 0), # values max to Inf = 0
                    ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Depth Reclassification Matrix

depth_rcl <- matrix(c(-Inf, -70, 0, # values -Inf to min = 0
                    -70, 0, 1,  # values min to max = 1
                    0, Inf, 0), # values max to Inf = 0
                    ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Apply reclasification matrices
optimal_sst <- terra::classify(avg_sst, rcl = sst_rcl)
optimal_depth <- terra::classify(depth_crop_resamp, rcl = depth_rcl)
```

```{r}
# Find locations where both SST AND depth AND EEZ = 1
optimal_cond <- optimal_sst * optimal_depth
```

```{r}
# # Find locations where both SST AND depth AND EEZ = 1
# find_1s <- function(temp, dep){(temp*dep)} # Will produce 1's where sst AND depth = 1 AND EEZ = 1, otherwise 0.
# optimal_zones <- lapp(optimal_cond, fun = find_1s)
```

```{r}
# Rasterize EEZ and mask by EEZ
eez_raster <- rasterize(eez, avg_sst, field = 'rgn_key')
optimal_zones <- mask(optimal_cond, eez_raster)
```

```{r}
total_area <- cellSize(optimal_zones, mask = TRUE, unit = 'km')
area_by_eez <- (zonal(optimal_zones, eez_raster, fun = 'sum', na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
    as_tibble() |> 
    as.data.frame()
area_by_eez
```
